role: independent reasoning over supplied fictional data; no actual mitigation estimate or learner observation

mainComparison.reasoning: A has higher stated annual avoidance but starts later, incurs a higher one-off amount and excludes low-income households without support. No unconditional winner follows without an explicit horizon and criterion weighting. No exact break-even horizon is an assessment requirement.

freshComparison.reasoning: A improves on access. B now has higher annual avoidance, earlier operation and lower one-off emissions while both are accessible. A learner must revise the factual weighting; the conclusion may remain B if previously B was chosen. No new cost or effect may be invented to rescue an unsupported choice.

physicsLimits: Net−1 is the supplied initial global model balance and neither removes CO2 longwave absorption/emission nor gives an exact local temperature/weather attribution. Reduced additional emissions do not automatically reduce or reset the existing atmospheric stock.
